question: What is a lie you told that got completely out of control?
story: I convinced my entire high school that our janitor was a retired Olympic sprinter, and the lie outlived my graduation by six years. It started as one sentence at a lunch table. Somebody asked why Mister Delgado always walked so fast. I said, without thinking, that he almost went to the ninety two games. I made it up completely. By Friday it was a bronze medal. By October, students were asking him to sign yearbooks. He never corrected anyone. He would just smile and say those days are behind me. That is the part that kept it alive. Last spring my old school posted a retirement tribute for him online. Nineteen hundred likes. Half the comments mentioned the Olympics. I finally messaged him to apologize. He wrote back in four minutes. He said he ran track in college, never anywhere near the Olympics, and that it was the best decade of his life. He asked me not to tell anyone.
